newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end up on Wall St, tax break hopes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end up on Wall St, tax break hopes.

text.p: Brazilian shares pared early losses to end higher, led by Telebras, on Wall Street's strong rises and optimism the government may exempt stocks from the new CPMF financial transaction tax, brokers said.
"Interest today was mostly focused on Telebras," one broker said.
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index .BVSP of 49 most-traded shares climbed 0.37 percent to end at 74,542 points on hefty turnover of 583.4 million reais ($561 million).
